integrity: The continuum statement is proved symbolically. Exact-rational computations are regression checks only and are not treated as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: The explicit family proves sharpness for \(0<\varepsilon<1\); no classification of equality cases is claimed.
The literature comparison cannot rule out an obscure or unindexed independent occurrence.
title: Sharpness of the \(\varepsilon/2\) right-additivity coefficient
